editionLabel: Cardinal 20 Domino Games instructions: Draw and Block games (English)
firstPlayerRule: Decide the leader before the game starts. That player may lead any domino and leads at the start of each new hand.
houseFallback: Use the picker to choose the leader.
clarifications: Block is the same game as Draw, except players pass instead of drawing when they cannot play.
In Muggins, from the same booklet, the highest double leads instead.
internalEvidence: Fetched Cardinal’s instruction PDF from its cardinalcdn host and extracted its text with pdftotext. "DRAW: Each player draws seven pieces. Any domino can be lead. The leader is determined before the game starts. It leads at the beginning of each new hand". "BLOCK: The same game as ‘Draw’ except that excess pieces are not drawn when a player cannot play." "MUGGINS: Each player draws seven pieces. The highest double leads."
uncertainty: The rules do not say how the leader is determined.
